Spark Sessions: Origami Flowers Youth (Ages 13 – 17) | Free, Drop-In Program September 26 (PA DAY) | 2:00 – 3:00 pm Underground Gallery (Level B1) | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Kick off the school year in the Aurora Cultural Centre’s first Spark Session! Spark Sessions are free, recurring, student-led arts and craft workshops for youth from ages 13 to 17. Each Spark Session is themed, with materials and snacks provided at no cost (while quantities last). This session’s theme: Origami Flowers About Youth Artists on the Rise! (YAR): Spark Sessions run as part of Youth Artists on the Rise! (YAR), a community for arts-impassioned youth ages 13-17 to develop their skills in the arts, make connections, and build a community for collaboration and growth. Participants have access to art studio space, exhibiting opportunities, and workshops. Register for YAR now!
